entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought this jersey and it's completely unacceptable. I want a refund right now!
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase, and I apologize for the wait time. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF8675309. And don't give me the runaround. This thing is ridiculously small. It's supposed to be a Large, but it's so tight I can barely get it on. This is false advertising!

I understand your frustration. Just to make sure I'm addressing the problem correctly, is the issue that it's the wrong size and fit for you, or is there a technical fault or defect with the jersey itself?

I just told you, it's the wrong size! It's too tight! Are you even listening? This is the worst service I've ever had. I want to speak to your manager and I'm leaving a one-star review on every website I can find.

I assure you, I am listening, and I believe I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate the call. I see here you received the order seven days ago. Sizing issues like this are no problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return window for apparel.
So you can actually do something? What does that mean?
It means we can definitely help. We can either process a full refund for you, or we can set up an exchange for a larger size at no extra cost. Whichever you prefer.
Oh. Well... an exchange would be good, I guess. I like the color. Can you just send me the next size up?

Absolutely. I can start that exchange process for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. Just send the original jersey back to us, and as soon as it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you. Does that sound good?
Okay. Yes, that works. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for your help.
Alright. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
